notes.title: Espionage Activity Releases July 30!
notes.notes:
I am thrilled to announce that Espionage Activity is releasing on July 30, 2024!

It's been a long time coming and I can't wait to get the game into your hands! Until then I'd love to chat about the game on [url=https://discord.gg/MFc24B575g]discord[/url].

See you in two weeks!

notes.title: Next Fest Broadcast 2 - Watch the Developer Try to Speedrun the Demo!
notes.notes: Broadcast #2 will once again be footage of my attempts to speedrun the demo!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest: Watch the Developer Try to Speedrun the Demo!
notes.notes:
Join me in watching some footage of my attempts to speedrun the game demo!

I'll be pushing for the fastest time possible, while also completing secondary objectives like collecting all logs or doing a no-alert run!

notes.title: Espionage Activity Demo 1.02 Hotfix Update
notes.notes:
What better way to kick off Next Fest than by discovering a bunch of bugs ːsteamsadː

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed various issues relating to controller navigation
[*] Fixed an issue where log collection progress would not reset on starting a new game
[*] Fixed an issue where defeating spider bots would count as a guard elimination
[/list]

notes.title: Espionage Activity Demo Patch 1.01 Notes
notes.notes:
Update 1.01 for the Espionage Activity demo is now live! This is a small update to fix some bugs and polish issues.

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug causing player to enter free camera mode when a specific input was pressed
[*] Fixed background pop-in on main menu load in
[*] Updated main menu BGM
[/list]

notes.title: Public Demo is Live!
notes.notes:
I'm happy to announce that the public demo for Espionage Activity is now live!

This demo includes the complete first section of the game, with a modified scoring system balanced for this section only.

Try it now and let me know what you think!
